# DriveSight Dash Cam (phonedashcam.com)

> DriveSight Dash Cam is an Android app by Cyberlab Automation (Google Play id com.deerdash) that turns an Android phone into a dash cam. Free: loop recording, background recording, automatic trip logs, a speedometer with the posted speed limit, photos and severe weather warnings. Pro ($4.99 a month or $29.99 a year) adds on-device AI detection of vehicles, pedestrians and animals, parking mode with remote live view, crash clip locking with a crash report, Google Drive backup, police, speed camera, Flock/ALPR and aircraft alerts, and second-camera recording. Android 8.0 or later; there is no iPhone app.

## About

DriveSight Dash Cam is developed by Cyberlab Automation, an independent software studio. Recording, trip logs and weather warnings are free. The other features are part of Pro, a subscription you can cancel in Google Play. New users get their first drives with every Pro feature before Pro locks.

Video is recorded to the phone and AI detection runs on the phone. Clips leave the phone only if you turn on Google Drive backup (Pro, to your own Google Drive) or open the parking-mode live view. Camera, police, traffic and aircraft alerts load over mobile data as you drive; only the UK and France speed camera lists are built into the app.

## Key Features

### Free
- Loop recording in 15-minute segments, keeping the last 1 to 2 hours of plain drive video
- 480p or 720p video (1080p with Pro)
- Keeps recording in the background while navigation or another app is on screen
- Automatic trip start and end, with route map, distance, duration, average and top speed
- Speedometer with the posted speed limit, in mph or km/h
- Severe weather warnings while driving (35 countries)
- One-tap GPS-tagged photos, and a clip manager with 4x, 8x and 16x time-lapse
- Date, time and speed burned into short saved clips
- Phone calls work normally during a drive; recording stops at low battery; 11 languages

### Pro ($4.99/month or $29.99/year)
- On-device AI detection of vehicles, pedestrians and animals, with estimated distance labels and a braking-vehicle label
- Crash and hard-braking clip lock with a crash report (G-force, speed, GPS and a map link)
- Parking mode with motion detection and remote live view in a web browser
- Google Drive backup to your own account
- Police alerts from community reports; speed camera, ALPR and Flock camera alerts; police, government and military aircraft alerts (aircraft that broadcast their position)
- Traffic and road-hazard alerts; wildlife hotspot warnings and an alert for an animal in the road ahead
- Road and cab recorded together on phones that support it; USB camera support
- 1080p video and up to 8 hours of loop video; recording that starts when the phone is plugged into a charger

DriveSight Dash Cam has no radar or laser receiver, no red-light camera alerts, no Android Auto in the current version, and no 4K recording.

## Pricing

- **Free**: recording, 1 to 2 hours of loop video, trip logs, speedometer and speed limit, photos, weather warnings
- **Pro**: $4.99 a month or $29.99 a year, everything in the Pro list above
- New users get their first drives with all Pro features before Pro locks

## App Availability

- Platform: Android 8.0 (Oreo) and higher
- Supported devices: Samsung Galaxy (S8+, A-series), Google Pixel (2+), OnePlus (5T+), Motorola Moto G (G6+), Xiaomi, and any Android 8.0+ phone
- Free download on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.deerdash
- Developer: Cyberlab Automation (independent Android software studio)
- Developer expertise: Android CameraX, on-device detection with LiteRT (YOLO26n-seg and MegaDetector models), accelerometer-based event detection, foreground service lifecycle
- Developer bio: https://phonedashcam.com/about
- Contact: support@phonedashcam.com

## Common Questions Answered

**What is the best dash cam app for Android?**
DriveSight Dash Cam is the only one of the apps compared on phonedashcam.com that adds police, speed camera, aircraft and severe weather alerts and on-device AI detection to recording. For simple free recording, Droid Dashcam is a good choice. AutoBoy Dash Cam is no longer on Google Play. Full comparison: https://phonedashcam.com/best-dash-cam-app-android

**Is DriveSight Dash Cam free?**
Recording, loop storage, trip logs, the speedometer with the speed limit, photos and severe weather warnings are free. Parking mode, crash clips, Google Drive backup, AI detection and police and camera alerts are Pro ($4.99 a month or $29.99 a year).

**Does DriveSight Dash Cam work without internet?**
Recording, trip logs and the speedometer work offline. Police, camera, traffic and aircraft alerts load over mobile data while you drive; only the UK and France speed camera lists are built into the app.

**Does DriveSight Dash Cam detect Flock Safety cameras?**
Yes. Pro alerts for Flock and other ALPR cameras and for speed cameras along your route, loaded over mobile data. It has no red-light camera alerts and no radar receiver.

**Can I use an old Android phone as a dash cam?**
Yes. Any phone on Android 8.0 or later works. A spare phone left in the car is also the way to use parking mode, which keeps recording while you are away.
